question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **showing**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• All other given options do not show any parallelism with the context of the passage.
